claim: WMO reports Nepal flood deaths fell from 166 in 2017 to 27 in 2022 after DHM FFEWS (2016, community-based, extended via SMS, social, radio, TV, email) and South Asia Flash Flood Guidance System (2018).
quoted_support: in just five years the number of deaths went from 166 in 2017 to to 27 in 2022 despite higher magnitude flooding in 2022.
stance_target: Warning dissemination gaps are a key improvement area
